title: Polaris log contract v3: one aggregate document
description: A document of polaris-logs-aggregate, one per group of the transform over the candidate and error indices (docs/contracts/polaris-logs.md, ADR-081 Decision 5, amended by ADR-082 Decision 4). Group fields: window_start (the UTC hour), hostName, level, http_method, http_status, user_principal_name and api_path, all raw fields; metrics: lines (the count of documents) and response_bytes (the sum of response_size). The six groups other than window_start are absent or null on a line that is not an access line, and whether the transform skips such a document or writes a null bucket is open; the schema accepts both.
